authority_boundary: This document records the canonical AICAD mechanical standards ledger and project scope decisions. It does not reproduce the standards, certify compliance, or prove that an edition remains current at release time.
scope_policy: Use these rows only to control prototype drawing vocabulary and evidence planning. Obtain controlled copies, confirm licensing, edition, jurisdiction and applicability with the responsible engineer before manufacturing release.
